observations.behavior: Adds three new string constants with specific messages distinguishing between general billing access denial, spend data access denial, and project-specific access denial.
observations.posthog_connection: These strings replace generic permission error messages in the billing API, allowing downstream consumers to distinguish authorization failures that require role changes versus those requiring scope adjustments.

observations.behavior: Replaces a hardcoded permission denied message with one of the newly defined context-aware messages depending on whether it's an org-level check.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes user-facing error responses; this could help automated agents or support diagnostics differentiate why a request failed without changing status codes.

observations.behavior: Adds assertions checking response body details against the new constant values rather than just status code.
observations.posthog_connection: Tests verify that permission errors carry these distinct payloads, supporting dependent systems or documentation relying on payload differentiation.

observations.limitations: Only examined provided hunks. No broader system behavior or compatibility checks were reviewed. The change does not alter authentication or token handling, only the content of rejection messages.

review.limitations: Only examined provided hunks. No broader system behavior or compatibility checks were reviewed. The change does not alter authentication or token handling, only the content of rejection messages.
review.reason: The patch introduces three new constants for distinguishing billing-related permission denials and updates several endpoints and tests accordingly. This is a substantive bounded improvement: clearer API contracts and better diagnostic information, but no systemic architectural change or broad capability expansion.
review.posthog_relevance: Could benefit PostHog by improving clarity for machine-readable consumers and human debugging when billing access fails. It also supports documented agent workflows described in accompanying docs.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies solely on supplied chunk; other hunks or configuration changes could affect overall impact.
